subject: Re: FAD status: Beam Python 2 blocker + panel validation
body:
Team,

Decision from this morning's sync: we take the two weeks. The Python 2 pipeline does not go to Launch Review Board; Maren's Python 3 Beam rewrite is now on the critical path, with the LRB slot moving from May 22 to Jun 5 pending Nadia's confirmation.

Second decision: we ship v1 on the VGGish embedding model as-is. Swapping the embedding backbone is a Q3 conversation — it changes every historical score and the harness needs stable baselines first.

Hyun, please write up the 9/10 vs 6/10 panel-agreement result for the review packet; that is our headline number.

Thanks all — good, fast work this cycle.

Goran
